summary: The A1 vocabulary has lowercase nouns. B1–B2 has many wrong-meaning translations: 'Kulturelle Mittel' for cultural appropriation, 'Vergemeinschaftung' for commodification, 'bedeutungsvollsten' for most contentious, 'selbsterhaltende' for self-serving, 'von der Skala ... getroffen', 'Urlaub' (vacation) for a holiday, and a historiography definition that drops its meaning. A Shakespeare item sits in the German culture file, three cloze items lack a blank, and one dialogue_turn has no situation.
